title: Design System: MMMHMC Authentication Entry Surface

headline.purpose: Sign-in and equivalent authentication task titles.

body.purpose: Primary explanatory copy beside the authentication task.

label.purpose: Field labels and compact task headings.

detail.purpose: Field help, security, and assistance copy.

shadows.name: signin-light
shadows.purpose: The sole substantial elevation on the light authentication surface.

shadows.name: signin-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark-theme counterpart for the elevated sign-in surface.

shadows.name: action-rest
shadows.purpose: Compact depth under the primary sign-in action.

shadows.name: action-hover
shadows.purpose: Slightly stronger response when the primary action is hovered.

motion.name: portal-entrance
motion.purpose: Progressively reveal the headline, workforce constellation, and sign-in surface from a 14px rise.

motion.name: system-orbit
motion.purpose: Revolve the two workforce-system paths continuously in opposite directions; pause when hidden and omit under reduced motion.

motion.name: system-pulse
motion.purpose: Give the three connection points a slow continuous breathing rhythm without introducing a second accent.

motion.name: control-response
motion.purpose: Smooth hover, focus, and press feedback on fields and the primary action.

motion.name: theme-indicator
motion.purpose: Restrained movement of the theme control indicator.

components.name: Primary Sign-in Button
components.description: The single dominant action on authentication entry surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; min-height:3.15rem; padding:0 1rem; border:0; border-radius:.6rem; background:#235d90; color:#fff; box-shadow:0 .8rem 1.8rem -1.2rem rgba(35,93,144,.8); font-family:'Manrope Variable',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.82rem; font-weight:760; transition:transform 150ms ease,background-color 150ms ease,box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#194b77; box-shadow:0 1rem 2rem -1.15rem rgba(35,93,144,.88); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(35,93,144,.24); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor:wait; opacity:.68; transform:none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Employee ID Field
components.description: A labeled authentication field with persistent operational help.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:.48rem; color:#2f4458; font-family:'Manrope Variable',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:720; } .ds-field input { width:100%; min-height:3rem; padding:0 .85rem; border:1px solid #bdcbd6; border-radius:.6rem; outline:none; background:#fbfcfd; color:#172433; caret-color:#235d90; font:400 .88rem 'Manrope Variable',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:border-color 150ms ease,box-shadow 150ms ease,background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#52677b; opacity:1; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:#8ba2b5; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color:#235d90; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 0 0 .2rem rgba(35,93,144,.13); } .ds-field input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color:#b73a4b; } .ds-field small { color:#52677b; font-size:.71rem; font-weight:400; } :host-context(html[data-theme='dark']) .ds-field { color:#cedae4; } :host-context(html[data-theme='dark']) .ds-field input { border-color:#40576b; background:#0c1925; color:#e8f0f7; caret-color:#76a9d4; } :host-context(html[data-theme='dark']) .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#9badbd; } :host-context(html[data-theme='dark']) .ds-field input:focus { border-color:#76a9d4; background:#0a1722; box-shadow:0 0 0 .2rem rgba(118,169,212,.15); }

components.name: Sign-in Card
components.description: The sole elevated task container on the authentication gateway.
components.html:
Sign in to continue

Use the credentials issued to you.

Authentication form
components.css: .ds-signin-card { padding:clamp(1.75rem,3vw,2.5rem); border-radius:1rem; background:#fff; color:#172433; box-shadow:0 1.8rem 4.5rem -3.1rem rgba(28,71,108,.62); font-family:'Manrope Variable',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; animation:ds-signin-enter 560ms 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; } .ds-signin-card h2 { margin:0; font-size:1.85rem; font-weight:770; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-signin-card>p { margin:.35rem 0 0; color:#52677b; font-size:.8rem; } .ds-card-placeholder { margin-top:1.75rem; padding:1rem; border:1px dashed #bdcbd6; border-radius:.6rem; color:#52677b; font-size:.75rem; } @keyframes ds-signin-enter { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(12px); } to { opacity:1; transform:none; } } :host-context(html[data-theme='dark']) .ds-signin-card { background:#101f2d; color:#e8f0f7; box-shadow:0 1.8rem 4.5rem -3rem rgba(0,0,0,.72); } :host-context(html[data-theme='dark']) .ds-signin-card>p { color:#a8b9c9; } :host-context(html[data-theme='dark']) .ds-card-placeholder { border-color:#40576b; color:#a8b9c9; } @media (max-width:600px) { .ds-signin-card { padding:1.4rem; border-radius:.85rem; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-signin-card { animation:none; } }

components.name: Remember Selection
components.description: A compact persisted-session control that stays subordinate to submit.
components.css: .ds-remember { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.65rem; color:#42586c; font:400 .74rem 'Manrope Variable',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-remember input { appearance:none; width:1.05rem; height:1.05rem; flex:none; border:1.5px solid #8ba2b5; border-radius:.25rem; background:#fff; } .ds-remember input:checked { border-color:#235d90; background:#235d90; } .ds-remember input:checked::after { display:block; width:.65rem; height:.35rem; margin:.2rem 0 0 .16rem; border-bottom:2px solid white; border-left:2px solid white; content:''; transform:rotate(-45deg); } .ds-remember input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(35,93,144,.2); outline-offset:2px; } :host-context(html[data-theme='dark']) .ds-remember { color:#b7c6d3; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: A compact secondary utility for explicit light and dark theme control.
components.css: .ds-theme { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; min-height:2.5rem; padding:0 .2rem 0 .7rem; border:1px solid rgba(35,93,144,.18); border-radius:.65rem; background:rgba(255,255,255,.58); color:#42586c; font:700 .7rem 'Manrope Variable',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:border-color 160ms ease,background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-theme i { position:relative; width:2.15rem; height:1.45rem; border-radius:.45rem; background:#d9e2e9; } .ds-theme i::after { position:absolute; top:.25rem; left:.25rem; width:.95rem; height:.95rem; border-radius:.28rem; background:#235d90; content:''; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-theme:hover { border-color:#235d90; background:rgba(255,255,255,.9); } .ds-theme:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(35,93,144,.22); outline-offset:2px; } :host-context(html[data-theme='dark']) .ds-theme { border-color:rgba(118,169,212,.2); background:rgba(18,34,49,.7); color:#bac9d6; } :host-context(html[data-theme='dark']) .ds-theme i { background:#263b4e; } :host-context(html[data-theme='dark']) .ds-theme i::after { background:#76a9d4; transform:translateX(.7rem); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-theme i::after { transition:none; } }

components.name: Authentication Alert
components.description: A focused, persistent server-validation failure message.
components.html: We couldn't sign you in.Check your credentials and try again.
components.css: .ds-login-alert { display:grid; gap:.2rem; padding:.8rem 1rem; border:1px solid #e7a3ab; border-radius:.7rem; background:#fff1f2; color:#a52b3b; font:400 .78rem 'Manrope Variable',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-login-alert:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(183,58,75,.22); outline-offset:2px; } :host-context(html[data-theme='dark']) .ds-login-alert { border-color:#71303a; background:#35161d; color:#ffb6bf; }

narrative.overview:
The authentication entry surface is a calm, institutional threshold into sensitive employee systems. It feels dependable rather than promotional: direct language, a cool neutral field, one restrained blue accent, and a sign-in card that is unmistakably the primary task.

This record applies to login and closely related authentication entry surfaces only. It does not establish visual rules for payroll processing, HR administration, reporting, tables, or other authenticated product screens. Within this boundary, employee self-service and HR/Accounting role context remain useful orientation, never competition for the sign-in action.
keyCharacteristics: Task-first hierarchy with sign-in as the dominant action.
Restrained institutional blue against cool, quiet neutrals.
Manrope Variable throughout, with firm weight contrast and compact support text.
A connected workforce constellation explains People, Time & Leave, and Payroll without competing with sign-in.
Light and dark themes that preserve the same hierarchy and interaction states.
Rounded controls and cards on a disciplined 10–16px surface scale.
Motion confined to the sign-in surface and removed under reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue alone carries action, focus, and selective emphasis; do not introduce a second decorative accent on authentication entry surfaces.

rules.name: The Parity Rule
rules.body: Dark mode preserves semantic roles and contrast rather than mechanically inverting light-theme values.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy with Manrope's variable weights and measured scale; do not add ornamental typefaces, all-caps slogans, or exaggerated letter spacing to this surface.

rules.name: The Task-Before-Context Rule
rules.body: On narrow screens, sign-in must appear before role details and security context.

rules.name: The Single Lift Rule
rules.body: The sign-in surface is the only elevated container; role summaries, security notes, header, and footer remain flat.

rules.name: The 10–16 Rule
rules.body: Keep the main control and surface radius vocabulary between roughly 10px and 16px; tiny checkbox and toggle internals are proportional exceptions, not new container shapes.

dos: Do make sign-in the strongest action and the only elevated container.
Do preserve Employee ID, password, remember-me, validation, help, and theme behaviors when reusing the surface.
Do maintain explicit light/dark token pairs and visible keyboard focus.
Do place sign-in before role details at 900px and below.
Do use the existing MMMHMC brand mark assets and Manrope Variable typography.
Do keep the workforce constellation explanatory, non-interactive, and subordinate to sign-in.
donts: Don't turn authentication entry into a marketing landing page or give role summaries competing calls to action.
Don't use multicolor decorative gradients, extra accent hues, or decorative cards; background gradients must remain low-contrast atmosphere rather than competing emphasis.
Don't use pill-shaped fields or buttons; keep the main 10–16px radius vocabulary.
Don't promote these entry-surface rules into unrelated payroll or administration screens without separate evidence.
Don't hide access errors in transient toasts or color-only states.
Don't show the workforce constellation on narrow screens or turn its nodes into competing navigation cards.
